page.notes: The left-margin note "§. II." is a section letter and is placed in the heading. The text is cut off at the bottom of this part, so the final line of the second paragraph may continue on the next part. The reference mark {d} in the first paragraph has no visible note in this part. The small superscript word between "novis" and "spreto" is too small to read and is marked as illegible. The left-margin notes are set in very small italic type and several words are doubtful, marked [?]. The footnote marks {f} and {h} are reconstructed from the reference marks in the text. The reference mark before "Videntur" is shown as {g}, and the mark before "Penes" as {h}. The margin note with "Abbatissam" and "hiant" is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Italic and roman type are as they appear. The Google watermark at the lower right is not transcribed.
